shared_facts: The deploy pipeline for api-gateway requires a passing smoke test before promoting to prod.
Customer Acme Corp is on the legacy billing plan until their contract renews in 2026-09.
The staging environment database is refreshed from a prod snapshot every Sunday at 02:00 UTC.
The on-call rotation for the platform team is tracked in the #oncall-platform Slack channel.
The api-gateway service is pinned to fastapi 0.136.3 due to a starlette upper-bound issue in 0.137.
New customer onboarding requires a signed DPA before any data import job runs.
The `orders` table's duplicate-row issue from the May migration was fixed by a dedup script, not a manual delete.
Feature flags for the new billing plan are controlled via the `billing-v2` LaunchDarkly project.

questions.question: What must pass before an api-gateway deploy is promoted to prod?
When can Acme Corp be moved to the new billing plan?
questions.reference_answer: Not until their contract renews in 2026-09.

questions.question: How and when is the staging database refreshed?
questions.reference_answer: From a prod snapshot every Sunday at 02:00 UTC.
